name: rdc-analyst
description: Analyze GPU captures and frame data from RenderDoc (.rdc files), PIX, or similar frame debuggers. Reconstructs render pass graphs, resource dependency chains, material/shader bindings, and pipeline state for a captured frame. Use when the user wants to understand how a frame is rendered, map out render passes and their resource dependencies, extract draw-call structure, identify redundant state changes, infer engine material or shader architecture, or build reusable render knowledge entries — rather than debugging a specific visual defect or crash.
